query: I spent two and a half years applying to thousands of jobs, finally got an entry-level office job, and now it may be automated away. Healthcare takes more than thirty percent of my income, I live with a parent, cannot afford a reliable car, and side work has not made independence possible. The long job search and instability coincided with three autoimmune illnesses, including permanent scarring and hair loss. I feel hopeless about the future. Is there anything psychologically wrong with me, or is this simply an impossible situation?
